annotations.title: Search standing offers and supply arrangements

description: Search active federal standing offers and supply arrangements issued by Public Services and Procurement Canada: pre-qualified suppliers that departments can buy from without a new open competition. Use it to see who already holds an agreement for a commodity, what a given supplier holds, or when agreements expire and may be re-competed. Agreement types: SA (supply arrangement), NMSO and RMSO (national and regional master standing offers), NISO, RISO and DISO (national, regional and departmental individual standing offers).

agreement_type.description: Agreement type code, e.g. SA, NMSO, RMSO, NISO, RISO, DISO.

commodity.description: UNSPSC commodity code or prefix; a segment or family code also matches every code beneath it.

department.description: Words from the department the agreement serves, in either language.

include_expired.description: Also return agreements whose expiry date has passed.

match.description: Whether a notice must contain all query terms or any of them. An explicit OR in the query always applies.

query.description: Keywords searched in agreement titles, commodity names, supplier names and departments. Words match in English and French, ignoring case and accents. Use "double quotes" for an exact phrase, a trailing * for a prefix (engineer*), and uppercase OR between alternatives.

region.description: Text contained in a delivery point, e.g. "Alberta" or "National Capital Region".

supplier.description: Words from the supplier legal, operating or standardized name.
